definitions.turnovers_sacks: Season-only interceptions/lost fumbles and sacks on eligible plays, divided by games.
definitions.qb_split: Team offense in games where the named QB owns at least 80% of identified pass plays and at least 10 passes. This is a game-level split, not a causal QB effect.
definitions.audit: Independent pandas aggregation of the same nflverse source. Reconciliation does not mean independent external verification or predictive calibration.

validation.reason: No established improvement across seasons or probability calibration. Experimental EPA correction is descriptive only; scoring baseline is the production research estimate.
validation.method: Retrospective prior-week walk-forward records, paired bootstrap by season/week (2000 draws). Not an untouched prospective holdout; not evidence of betting profitability.

score_candidate.method: Opponent-adjusted offensive/defensive scoring ratings and historical QB effects. Prior season downweighted; current weeks weighted by recency. Other injuries and drive-level efficiency are not modeled. Candidate does not replace the displayed baseline or authorize a bet.

SF.assumption: Assumes the last observed quarterback starts; this is not a confirmed lineup.

MIN.assumption: Assumes the last observed quarterback starts; this is not a confirmed lineup.

units.method: Same-team score residuals with all listed players absent versus all present, after opponent/QB scoring fit; shrunk toward zero. Descriptive association, not a causal injury penalty.

definitions.sample: Completed regular-season games before the target week; run/pass plays, no_play excluded; finite EPA required.
definitions.epa: Mean source EPA per eligible play. Positive defense EPA allowed favors the opposing offense.
